sentences.text: OF THE LEARNED SINGLE JUDGE DATED 15-03-2023 IN W.P. NO.202720/2022 AND PUNISH THE ACCUSED NOS.1 TO 3 WITH LAW, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THIS CCC COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE R.DEVDAS  AND  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE G BASAVARAJA
ORAL ORDER
(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE R.DEVDAS)

On going through the orders passed by the learned Single Judge, we find that the complainants herein had filed the writ petition seeking a writ of mandamus directing respondent No.3 namely, the Special Land Acquisition Officer, KIADB to consider the representations given by the petitioners on 22.08.2022.

Accordingly, the learned Single Judge directed by order dated 15.03.2023 that the respondent No.3 - SLAO shall consider the representations in accordance with law within eight weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of the order.

We find that in the representations given by the complainants herein they allege that the respondents have utilized lands in excess of what was notified and therefore they are seeking determination of compensation and payment of same to the complainants.

We have pointed out to the learned counsel that even if it is found that excess land has been utilized beyond what was notified, then it is only the State Government which has got the power to notify the excess lands for acquisition and thereafter the SLAO will get the authority to determine the compensation.

However,
the representations have been given to the SLAO who has no power or authority to notify the excess lands which are alleged to have been utilized beyond what was notified.

3. At this juncture, learned counsel for the complainants seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the complaint and give fresh representations to the State Government and the SLAO for redressal of their grievance.
